prompt:
Original Taiwanese game art for "Tainan Gazetteer" (府城夜巡地圖), set in Tainan around 1930.
Style: handmade layered paper sculpture (紙雕 / kirie), the same for buildings, trees, plants,
fences, ground tiles, icons and props. Every shape is a piece of cut paper: visible paper fibres,
slightly soft hand-cut edges, pieces overlapping in shallow layers with small soft contact shadows
where one sheet sits on another. Colour is printed on the paper: clearly visible risograph /
stencil print grain and uneven ink density across every flat area, never a clean digital fill.
Weathering is welcome: irregular faded patches, not neat squares.
Details are built from few, large cut pieces (roof tiles, bricks, window frames, leaves, petals,
stones, planks), not painted lines and not crowded tiny patterns. Plants are natural and
asymmetric.
Colour: follow the real object, then mute it: pale, slightly greyed, warm. Typical tones: warm
cream, pale brick red, coral, sage and grey-green, mustard, indigo, wood brown, stone grey.
No saturated red-against-green contrast.
Buildings: strictly frontal elevation, no perspective, three or four flat paper layers.
Do NOT make: a 3D render or clay/plastic model, smooth bevelled relief, realistic or painterly
illustration, photo textures, thick foam layers, glow, glossy highlights, black outline strokes,
smooth gradients, depth of field.
Output: generated natively on a fully TRANSPARENT background (real alpha including enclosed
holes, no backdrop, no glow, no chroma-key colour, no coloured fringe), every object complete
and separated by clear transparent gutters, no ground, no base, no cast shadow outside the
object, no text, no captions, no logos.

Create fences.png, a landscape 3-column by 2-row sprite sheet of six equal square cells for modular wooden fence pieces. Use only fence-ours.png as the style reference for the warm brown fibrous cut-paper wood, subtle irregular faded ink, and hand-cut tops. Strictly frontal flat shapes with no visible top or side planes. No decorations or additional pieces. All wood is uniformly warm brown with only natural tonal variation. Top row: three isolated centered upright pieces with their bottoms exactly aligned at the bottom of their cells. Left: one slim tall picket, subtly asymmetrical clipped/rounded top. Center: one thicker squared timber post, subtly different height and hand-cut crown. Right: one short timber post for a low flower bed fence. Each stands nearly upright with slight handmade irregularity. Bottom row, in matching column order: left exactly two equal-thickness horizontal plank rails, middle exactly one broad horizontal rail and one distinctly thinner horizontal rail below it, right exactly one low horizontal rail. No uprights in the bottom row. Rail spans are exactly one full cell width with square, level flush ends for clean joins; leave large vertical transparent gaps between the rails. Rail heights measured from each cell bottom must lie within the matching post heights; the single low rail sits in the bottom third. The only edge contacts are the posts at their cell bottoms and the rails at cell left/right boundaries. Keep the six cells equal and invisible, with fully transparent empty areas and no shadows outside the wood. Do not include plank arrays, diagonally arranged boards, diagonal two-tone fills, grid lines, letters, captions, backgrounds, or glow.
Critical alpha requirement: this is a flat die-cut production sprite sheet. Empty pixels must be zero alpha, including immediately outside every cut edge. No ambient light of any kind. Keep the paper uniformly matte to the cut edge. At every post crown show only the single frontal brown paper face: the clipped corners define the silhouette without any highlight band or bevel. The layout is an edge-to-edge production grid: bottoms of the top-row posts stop exactly at the middle of the sheet, and the bottom-row rails are flat strips that are clipped by their left and right cell boundaries.
notes: 內建 image_gen 原生 alpha；唯一風格輸入圖為 art-source/refs/fence-ours.png。每格 496 × 496 px，keys 依欄序，上排柱、下排同欄連接段。排表時裁齊柱底及橫木兩側，保留零件像素的原生 alpha。柱頂留有窄的亮色紙邊。
